description: Enhanced custom-error-page edge cases: when multiple templates exist the one matching the signalled status is chosen, template arguments are HTML-escaped on render, a nested inner set that defines a different status falls through to an outer template that defines the signalled status, a status defined by neither nested set falls through to the outer root which emits the generic page, and a backend that signals an error via the standard plaintext error path (rather than the templated context) bypasses the custom template and produces a plain-text body. Each case reports the response status, content type and rendered body.

cases.expected_output:
status=502 content_type=text/html; charset=utf-8 body=

502 Bad Gateway
